Endemic Bird Day. Date: 2026-05-10T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP marks Endemic Bird Day by raising awareness about India’s native bird species and their conservation.

World Bee Day. Date: 2026-05-20T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP celebrates World Bee Day by spreading awareness about the importance of bees in pollination and ecosystem balance. The zoo promotes conservation efforts to protect bees and support biodiversity.

International Biodiversity Day. Date: 2026-05-22T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP is a show case of Bio- diversity. Diversity of life form of the Zoo can form a basis of talk. Talks and film on these aspects can be arranged for visitors.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Turtle Day & World Turtle Day
nodes.description: International Turtle Day & World Turtle Day. Date: 2026-05-23T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP observes World Turtle Day and International Turtle Day by raising awareness about turtle conservation and habitat protection. The zoo highlights efforts to safeguard turtles and ensure their survival in the wild.

World Environment Day. Date: 2026-06-05T00:00:00.000Z. Details: June-5 World Environment day NZP should make a point to improve overall environment of the enclosures on this day. This will improve the environment not only animal enclosures but also of Zoo as whole.

World Ocean Day. Date: 2026-06-08T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP observes World Ocean Day by spreading awareness about marine conservation and the importance of oceans. Educational activities and displays highlight the need to protect aquatic life and reduce pollution.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: World Sea Turtle Day
nodes.description: World Sea Turtle Day. Date: 2026-06-16T00:00:00.000Z. Details: June–16 – World Sea Turtle Day NZP can organize awareness programs, talks, and displays highlighting sea turtle conservation and protection of marine habitats.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: World Day to combat Desertification and Drought
nodes.description: World Day to combat Desertification and Drought. Date: 2026-06-17T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP can conduct awareness programs on land conservation, water management, and the impact of drought on wildlife habitats. The zoo can educate visitors about preventing land degradation and protecting ecosystems, as desertification affects biodiversity, food systems, and water resources worldwide.

World Crocodile day. Date: 2026-06-17T00:00:00.000Z. Details: June–17 – World Crocodile Day NZP can organize awareness talks and exhibits highlighting crocodile conservation and the importance of protecting wetland habitats.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Climate Change Day
nodes.description: International Climate Change Day. Date: 2026-06-21T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP can conduct interactive sessions, exhibitions, and campaigns to educate visitors about reducing carbon footprints and adopting sustainable lifestyles. The zoo can also highlight how climate change affects animal behavior, habitats, and biodiversity, encouraging conservation action.

World Giraffe Day. Date: 2026-06-21T00:00:00.000Z. Details: June–21 – World Giraffe Day NZP can organize awareness talks and exhibits highlighting giraffe conservation and threats to their natural habitats.

Van Mahotsav. Date: 2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP has ample area for plantation. This occasion should be utilized by planting more and more seedlings (local species) in and around enclosures and road sides. School children can be involved in this programme.

World Seabird Day. Date: 2026-07-03T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Seabird Day is observed every year on July 3 to raise awareness about seabirds and the threats they face in marine environments. It highlights the importance of protecting seabirds and their ocean habitats, encouraging global conservation efforts.

Shark Awareness Day. Date: 2026-07-14T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP can highlight the role of sharks in maintaining healthy ocean ecosystems through interactive exhibits and educational talks. Visitors can be sensitized about issues like overfishing and the importance of protecting marine biodiversity.

World Chimpanzee Day. Date: 2026-07-14T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Chimpanzee Day is celebrated every year on July 14 to raise awareness about chimpanzees and the need to protect them and their habitats. This Day reminds us that protecting chimpanzees also means protecting the forests they call home.

World Snake Day. Date: 2026-07-16T00:00:00.000Z. Details: July–16 – World Snake Day NZP can conduct live demonstrations and expert talks to dispel myths about snakes and explain their ecological role in controlling pests. Awareness sessions can also focus on snakebite prevention and the importance of conserving native snake species.

International Mangrove Day. Date: 2026-07-26T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Mangrove Day (officially World Mangrove Day) is observed every year on July 26 to raise awareness about the importance of mangrove ecosystems and their conservation.
International Tiger Day. Date: 2026-07-29T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Awareness is created by celebrating the day which generates massive awareness specially among youths.

National Tree Day. Date: 2026-07-31T00:00:00.000Z. Details: National Tree Day is a special day dedicated to planting and caring for trees, helping to protect the environment and promote a greener future.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Owl Awareness Day
nodes.description: International Owl Awareness Day. Date: 2026-08-04T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Owl Awareness Day is celebrated every year on August 4 to raise awareness about owls and the importance of protecting them.

World Lion Day. Date: 2026-08-10T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Lion Day is celebrated every year on August 10 to raise awareness about the conservation of lions and protect their natural habitats.This Day was launched in 2013 by conservationists, including Dereck Joubert and Beverly Joubert, to highlight the declining population of lions.
World Elephant Day. Date: 2026-08-12T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Elephant Day is observed every year on August 12 to raise awareness about the protection and conservation of elephants.
World Lizard Day. Date: 2026-08-14T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Lizard Day encourages people to learn more about lizards, remove myths and fears, and promote their conservation.

World Orangutan Day. Date: 2026-08-19T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Orangutan Day is observed every year on August 19 to raise awareness about orangutans and the urgent need to protect them. The day highlights conservation efforts for orangutans, which are among the most intelligent primates and are critically endangered.
World Mosquito Day. Date: 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z. Details: NZP can spread awareness about mosquito-borne diseases and the importance of maintaining clean surroundings within and around the zoo.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Whale Shark Day
nodes.description: International Whale Shark Day. Date: 2026-08-30T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Whale Shark Day is celebrated every year on August 30 to raise awareness about the conservation of the world’s largest fish—the whale shark.

National Wildlife Day. Date: 2026-09-04T00:00:00.000Z. Details: National Wildlife Day is celebrated every year on September 4 to raise awareness about protecting wildlife and preserving natural habitats. The day honors the work of conservationists like Steve Irwin, also known as the “Crocodile Hunter,” for his dedication to wildlife protection.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Red Panda Day
nodes.description: International Red Panda Day. Date: 2026-09-05T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Red Panda Day is celebrated to raise awareness about the conservation of red pandas. The day was started by the Red Panda Network to protect red pandas and their natural habitats.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Vulture Awareness Day
nodes.description: International Vulture Awareness Day. Date: 2026-09-06T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Vulture Awareness Day is observed to highlight the importance of vultures and promote their conservation.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: National Iguana Awareness Day
nodes.description: National Iguana Awareness Day. Date: 2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z. Details: National Iguana Awareness Day is celebrated every year on September 8 to raise awareness about iguanas, their care, and their conservation.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Snake Awareness Day
nodes.description: International Snake Awareness Day. Date: 2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Snake Awareness Day is observed every year on July 16 to raise awareness about snakes and their importance in nature. The day aims to remove fear and myths about snakes and promote their conservation.
World Rhino Day. Date: 2026-09-22T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Rhino Day is celebrated every year on September 22 to raise awareness about rhinos and the urgent need to protect them.
Elephant Appreciation Day. Date: 2026-09-22T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Elephant Appreciation Day reminds us to value and protect elephants, which are vital for maintaining healthy ecosystems.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Raccoon Appreciation Day
nodes.description: International Raccoon Appreciation Day. Date: 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Raccoon Appreciation Day encourages people to better understand raccoons, reduce negative myths about them, and promote coexistence with wildlife.

Wildlife Week. Date: 2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Wildlife Week is observed every year in India from 2nd to 8th October to raise awareness about the protection and conservation of wildlife and natural habitats.
World Animal Day. Date: 2026-10-04T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Animal Day is celebrated every year on October 4 to promote animal welfare and raise awareness about the protection of all animals.

National Salmon Day. Date: 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z. Details: National Salmon Day is observed every year on October 8 to celebrate salmon fish and highlight their ecological, cultural, and nutritional importance.

International Sloth Day. Date: 2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Sloth Day is observed every year on 20 October to raise awareness about sloths and the conservation of their natural habitats, especially the tropical rainforests of Central and South America.

Reptile Awareness Day. Date: 2026-10-21T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Reptile Awareness Day is an observance dedicated to educating people about reptiles—their ecological importance, conservation status, and often misunderstood behavior.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Snow Leopard day
nodes.description: International Snow Leopard day. Date: 2026-10-23T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Snow Leopard Day is observed every year on October 23 to raise awareness about the conservation of the snow leopard and the fragile mountain ecosystems it inhabits.

International Gibbon Day. Date: 2026-10-24T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Gibbon Day is observed to raise awareness about gibbons—small apes that play a vital role in forest ecosystems and are among the most threatened primates in the world.
Bison Day. Date: 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Bison Day (more commonly celebrated as World Bison Day) is observed to recognize the ecological, cultural, and conservation importance of bison.

Jellyfish Day. Date: 2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Jellyfish Day (often observed as World Jellyfish Day on November 3) is an awareness day dedicated to these ancient, fascinating marine animals and their role in ocean ecosystems.
World Birds Day. Date: 2026-11-12T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Birds Day is celebrated to highlight the importance of birds in nature, ecosystems, and human life, and to promote their conservation.

International Jaguar Day. Date: 2026-11-29T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Jaguar Day is observed every year on November 29 to raise global awareness about the conservation of jaguars and the protection of their natural habitats.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: World Wildlife Conservation Day
nodes.description: World Wildlife Conservation Day. Date: 2026-12-04T00:00:00.000Z. Details: World Wildlife Conservation Day is observed every year on December 4 to raise global awareness about protecting wild animals and preserving biodiversity.

International Cheetah Day. Date: 2026-12-04T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Cheetah Day is observed every year on December 4 to raise awareness about the conservation of cheetahs and the urgent need to protect their shrinking habitats.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: International Animal Rights Day
nodes.description: International Animal Rights Day. Date: 2026-12-10T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Animal Rights Day is observed every year on December 10 to promote the idea that animals deserve protection from cruelty and have basic rights to live free from exploitation and suffering.

International Monkey Day. Date: 2026-12-14T00:00:00.000Z. Details: International Monkey Day is observed every year on December 14 to celebrate monkeys, raise awareness about their intelligence, and highlight the need for their conservation and protection.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: Visit the Zoo Day
nodes.description: Visit the Zoo Day. Date: 2026-12-27T00:00:00.000Z. Details: “Visit the Zoo Day” is usually celebrated by schools and zoos as an educational awareness activity. It is used to encourage students and families to learn about wildlife conservation, animal behaviour, and biodiversity.

nodes.id: Calendar Event: Nandankanan Biological Park Foundation Day
nodes.description: Nandankanan Biological Park Foundation Day. Date: 2026-12-29T00:00:00.000Z. Details: Nandankanan Biological Park Foundation Day is celebrated every year on December 29 to mark the establishment of one of India’s most important zoological parks and wildlife conservation centres.
